decisions.reason: Leaving paragraph spacing and page density unchanged does not resolve or alter the separate uncertainty about the interior title page contents.
The decision concerns text spacing and page density, not chapter-image placement, dimensions, rendering quality, or visual defects.
Retaining the existing general page density does not change the copyright-page publisher line or any identified copyright-page rule.
The decision to retain existing paragraph spacing does not cancel or modify the independently requested italic styling for Mama's Hot Take text.
Paragraph spacing and page density do not change the requirement to update table-of-contents page numbers after book size is finalized.
Retaining the concise page layout does not alter the Chapter 12 subtitle hierarchy or capitalization requirements.
The layout decision does not affect the prohibition on the unintended literal newline artifact in the book title.
The source decision addresses interior text density and does not change the obligation to prepare back matter and author copy.
Keeping the current layout unchanged does not alter which manuscript file is authoritative or the requirement to preserve its content updates.
The decision is limited to interior paragraph spacing and page density and does not modify the independently defined paperback cover.
Interior layout spacing has no necessary effect on the KDP keyword content, delivery format, or intended use.
Retaining the existing visual density does not modify the manuscript's approved wording or copyediting goal.
